*"Right then. Work first."*

I don't need to plan. I need to work. Standing here thinking costs money I don't have. Felling timber is what I do—4 sim per unit, and it puts timber in my hands I can sell or use. I'll be working when they arrive, not standing idle explaining myself.

When she comes, I'll have actual work to demonstrate with—not empty talk about how it's done.
